evidence: Authored source, model/adapter, linked/handler, capture, failure and saved JSON tests; no native compiler or controller execution

contract.source: Whole numbered/active frame and tool source assignments accept complete JOINTPOS storage, array elements and function results
contract.conversion: Existing independent JOINTPOS-to-XYZWPREXT assignment conversion in the calling root task group with its explicit model/adapter and selected frame/tool
contract.groups: Destination group selects table storage only; linked routines retain calling root conversion context
contract.capture: Evaluate source and finish checked conversion before group/row selectors, then selectors once left-to-right; active target selection follows all earlier effects
contract.values: Retain complete CONFIG and three supplied external-axis fields in a detached row; validate geometry, joint width/padding and model limits
contract.failure: Failed conversion prevents selectors/publication; failed selectors retain completed source/callback effects; sticky abort still prevents publication
contract.publication: Use existing whole-row replacement; numbered rows may populate/repair, active rows require existing selected storage; selections/current state are not changed
contract.persistence: Published rows and explicit model settings use existing robot context JSON; callbacks, aliases and suspended execution are not restored

boundaries: No joint-to-field writes, writable system aliases or implicit model discovery
Direct context host table writes remain Cartesian; whole system model transfers use their separate publication contract
No native calibration, configuration branch selection, controller writes, motion or strict equivalence
